source.text: Οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν πάντες ὑπὸ τὴν νεφέλην ἦσαν καὶ πάντες διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης διῆλθον, καὶ πάντες εἰς τὸν Μωϋσῆν ἐβαπτίσαντο ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν βρῶμα ἔφαγον καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν ἔπιον πόμα, ἔπινον γὰρ ἐκ πνευματικῆς ἀκολουθούσης πέτρας, ἡ πέτρα δὲ ἦν ὁ Χριστός·

records.literal_gloss: Not I want for you to be ignorant, brothers, that the fathers of us all under the cloud were and all through the sea passed, \v 2 and all into the Moses were baptized in the cloud and in the sea, \v 3 and all the same spiritual food ate \v 4 and all the same spiritual drank drink; they were drinking for from a spiritual following rock, the rock but was the Christ;

en.L: For I do not want you to be unaware, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea, \v 2 and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea, \v 3 and all ate the same spiritual food, \v 4 and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they kept drinking from a spiritual rock that followed [them], and the rock was the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: For I want you to grasp this, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}: every one of our ancestors was under the cloud, and every one of them went through the sea. \v 2 All of them were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea. \v 3 All of them ate the same spiritual food, \v 4 and all of them drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from a spiritual rock that went along with them, and that rock was {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I want you to know what happened to our ancestors, the people of Israel, when Moses led them out of Egypt. The cloud of God's presence was over all of them, and all of them walked through the sea. \v 2 In the cloud and in the sea, all of them were baptized into Moses, and so they were joined to him as their leader. \v 3 All of them ate the same spiritual food that God gave them, \v 4 and all of them drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from a spiritual rock that went along with them, and that rock was {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Car je ne veux pas que vous ignoriez, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, que nos pères ont tous été sous la nuée, et que tous sont passés à travers la mer, \v 2 et que tous ont été baptisés en Moïse dans la nuée et dans la mer, \v 3 et que tous ont mangé la même nourriture spirituelle, \v 4 et que tous ont bu la même boisson spirituelle ; car ils buvaient à un rocher spirituel qui [les] suivait, et le rocher était le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Je veux que vous compreniez bien ceci, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} : tous nos ancêtres, sans exception, ont été sous la nuée, et tous ont traversé la mer. \v 2 Tous ont été baptisés en Moïse dans la nuée et dans la mer. \v 3 Tous ont mangé la même nourriture spirituelle, \v 4 et tous ont bu la même boisson spirituelle. Ils buvaient à un rocher spirituel qui les accompagnait, et ce rocher, c’était le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je veux que vous sachiez ce qui est arrivé à nos ancêtres, le peuple d’Israël, quand Moïse les a fait sortir d’Égypte. La nuée qui montrait que Dieu était présent était au-dessus d’eux tous, et tous ont traversé la mer à pied. \v 2 Dans la nuée et dans la mer, tous ont été baptisés en Moïse : ils ont été unis à lui comme à leur chef. \v 3 Tous ont mangé la même nourriture spirituelle, que Dieu leur donnait, \v 4 et tous ont bu la même boisson spirituelle. Ils buvaient à un rocher spirituel qui les accompagnait, et ce rocher, c’était le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Porque no quiero que {{plural_you:ignoren|ignoréis}}, hermanos, que nuestros padres estuvieron todos bajo la nube, y todos pasaron a través del mar, \v 2 y todos fueron bautizados en Moisés en la nube y en el mar, \v 3 y todos comieron el mismo alimento espiritual, \v 4 y todos bebieron la misma bebida espiritual; porque bebían de una roca espiritual que [los] seguía, y la roca era el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: Quiero que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} esto, hermanos: todos nuestros antepasados estuvieron bajo la nube, y todos atravesaron el mar. \v 2 Todos ellos fueron bautizados en Moisés en la nube y en el mar. \v 3 Todos comieron el mismo alimento espiritual, \v 4 y todos bebieron la misma bebida espiritual. Bebían de una roca espiritual que los acompañaba, y esa roca era {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: Hermanos, quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} lo que les pasó a nuestros antepasados, el pueblo de Israel, cuando Moisés los sacó de Egipto. La nube de la presencia de Dios estaba sobre todos ellos, y todos cruzaron el mar caminando. \v 2 En la nube y en el mar, todos fueron bautizados en Moisés, y así quedaron unidos a él como su líder. \v 3 Todos comieron el mismo alimento espiritual que Dios les dio, \v 4 y todos bebieron la misma bebida espiritual. Bebían de una roca espiritual que los acompañaba, y esa roca era {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana sitaki mkose kujua, ndugu, kwamba baba zetu wote walikuwa chini ya lile wingu, na wote walipita katikati ya bahari, \v 2 na wote walibatizwa katika Musa ndani ya wingu na ndani ya bahari, \v 3 na wote walikula chakula kilekile cha kiroho, \v 4 na wote walikunywa kinywaji kilekile cha kiroho; kwa maana walikuwa wakinywa kutoka kwenye mwamba wa kiroho uliowafuata, na mwamba huo ulikuwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Ndugu, nataka mfahamu jambo hili: mababu zetu wote walikuwa chini ya lile wingu, na wote walivuka bahari. \v 2 Wote walibatizwa wakawa wa Musa katika wingu na katika bahari. \v 3 Wote walikula chakula kilekile cha kiroho, \v 4 na wote walikunywa kinywaji kilekile cha kiroho. Walikunywa kutoka kwenye mwamba wa kiroho uliofuatana nao, na mwamba huo ulikuwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Ndugu, nataka mjue yaliyowapata mababu zetu, watu wa Israeli, Musa alipowaongoza kutoka Misri. Wingu lililoonyesha kuwapo kwa Mungu lilikuwa juu yao wote, na wote walitembea katikati ya bahari. \v 2 Katika wingu na katika bahari wote walibatizwa wakawa wa Musa, na hivyo wakaunganishwa naye kama kiongozi wao. \v 3 Wote walikula chakula kilekile cha kiroho ambacho Mungu aliwapa, \v 4 na wote walikunywa kinywaji kilekile cha kiroho. Walikunywa kutoka kwenye mwamba wa kiroho uliofuatana nao, na mwamba huo ulikuwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Vì thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi không muốn anh chị em không biết rằng các tổ phụ chúng ta đều đã ở dưới đám mây, và tất cả đều đã đi qua biển, \v 2 và tất cả đều đã chịu báp-têm vào Môi-se trong đám mây và trong biển, \v 3 và tất cả đều đã ăn cùng một thức ăn thuộc linh, \v 4 và tất cả đều đã uống cùng một thức uống thuộc linh; vì họ cứ uống từ một tảng đá thuộc linh đi theo [họ], và tảng đá ấy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em hiểu rõ điều này: tất cả tổ tiên chúng ta đều đã ở dưới đám mây, và tất cả đều đã đi qua biển. \v 2 Tất cả họ đều đã chịu báp-têm vào Môi-se trong đám mây và trong biển. \v 3 Tất cả họ đều đã ăn cùng một thức ăn thuộc linh, \v 4 và tất cả đều đã uống cùng một thức uống thuộc linh. Họ uống từ một tảng đá thuộc linh luôn đi theo họ, và tảng đá ấy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em biết điều đã xảy ra cho tổ tiên chúng ta, là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, khi Môi-se dẫn họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Đám mây cho thấy sự hiện diện của Đức Chúa Trời ở trên tất cả họ, và tất cả họ đều đã đi bộ qua biển. \v 2 Trong đám mây và trong biển, tất cả họ đều đã chịu báp-têm vào Môi-se, và như vậy họ được gắn bó với ông là người lãnh đạo của họ. \v 3 Tất cả họ đều đã ăn cùng một thức ăn thuộc linh mà Đức Chúa Trời ban cho, \v 4 và tất cả đều đã uống cùng một thức uống thuộc linh. Họ uống từ một tảng đá thuộc linh luôn đi theo họ, và tảng đá ấy là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 여러분이 이것을 모르기를 원하지 않습니다. 우리 조상들은 모두 구름 아래 있었고 모두 바다를 지나갔으며, \v 2 모두 구름과 바다에서 모세 안으로 세례를 받았고, \v 3 모두 같은 영적인 음식을 먹었고, \v 4 모두 같은 영적인 음료를 마셨습니다. 그들은 자기들을 따라오는 영적인 바위에서 마셨는데, 그 바위는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이셨습니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 여러분이 이것을 꼭 알기를 바랍니다. 우리 조상들은 모두 구름 아래 있었고, 모두 바다를 건넜습니다. \v 2 그들은 모두 구름과 바다에서 세례를 받아 모세에게 속하게 되었습니다. \v 3 그들은 모두 같은 영적인 음식을 먹었고, \v 4 모두 같은 영적인 음료를 마셨습니다. 그들은 자기들과 함께 다니는 영적인 바위에서 물을 마셨는데, 그 바위는 바로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이셨습니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 모세가 이스라엘 백성을 이집트에서 이끌어 냈을 때 우리 조상들에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. 하나님께서 함께하심을 보여 주는 구름이 그들 모두 위에 있었고, 그들은 모두 바다 가운데로 걸어서 건넜습니다. \v 2 그들은 모두 구름과 바다에서 모세 안으로 세례를 받았고, 그래서 모세를 지도자로 따르는 사람들이 되었습니다. \v 3 그들은 모두 하나님께서 주신 같은 영적인 음식을 먹었고, \v 4 모두 같은 영적인 음료를 마셨습니다. 그들은 자기들과 함께 다니는 영적인 바위에서 물을 마셨습니다. 그 바위는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이셨습니다.

pt.L: Pois não quero que vocês ignorem, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, que os nossos pais estiveram todos debaixo da nuvem, e todos passaram pelo mar, \v 2 e todos foram batizados em Moisés na nuvem e no mar, \v 3 e todos comeram o mesmo alimento espiritual, \v 4 e todos beberam a mesma bebida espiritual; pois bebiam de uma rocha espiritual que [os] seguia, e a rocha era o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Pois quero que vocês entendam isto, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}: todos os nossos antepassados estiveram debaixo da nuvem, e todos eles atravessaram o mar. \v 2 Todos eles foram batizados em Moisés, na nuvem e no mar. \v 3 Todos eles comeram o mesmo alimento espiritual, \v 4 e todos eles beberam a mesma bebida espiritual. Bebiam de uma rocha espiritual que os acompanhava, e essa rocha era {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, quero que vocês saibam o que aconteceu com os nossos antepassados, o povo de Israel, quando Moisés os tirou do Egito. A nuvem da presença de Deus estava sobre todos eles, e todos eles atravessaram o mar a pé. \v 2 Na nuvem e no mar, todos eles foram batizados em Moisés, e assim ficaram unidos a ele como o seu líder. \v 3 Todos eles comeram o mesmo alimento espiritual que Deus lhes deu, \v 4 e todos eles beberam a mesma bebida espiritual. Bebiam de uma rocha espiritual que ia com eles, e essa rocha era {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.

am.L: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ይህን ሳታውቁ እንድትቀሩ አልወድምና፤ አባቶቻችን ሁሉ ከደመናው በታች ነበሩ፤ ሁሉም በባሕሩ መካከል አለፉ፤ \v 2 ሁሉም በደመናውና በባሕሩ ለሙሴ ተጠመቁ፤ \v 3 ሁሉም ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ ምግብ በሉ፤ \v 4 ሁሉም ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ መጠጥ ጠጡ፤ ይከተላቸው ከነበረው ከመንፈሳዊው ዓለት ይጠጡ ነበርና፤ ያም ዓለት {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነበረ።
am.B: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ይህን እንድታስተውሉ እወዳለሁ፤ አባቶቻችን እያንዳንዳቸው ከደመናው በታች ነበሩ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም በባሕሩ መካከል አለፉ። \v 2 ሁሉም በደመናውና በባሕሩ ለሙሴ ተጠመቁ። \v 3 ሁሉም ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ ምግብ በሉ፤ \v 4 ሁሉም ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ መጠጥ ጠጡ። ከእነርሱ ጋር አብሮ ከሚሄደው ከመንፈሳዊው ዓለት ጠጡ፤ ያም ዓለት {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነበረ።
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ሙሴ ከግብፅ ባወጣቸው ጊዜ በአባቶቻችን በእስራኤል ሕዝብ ላይ የሆነውን እንድታውቁ እፈልጋለሁ። የእግዚአብሔርን መገኘት የሚያሳየው ደመና በሁሉም ላይ ነበር፤ ሁሉም በባሕሩ መካከል ተሻገሩ። \v 2 በደመናውና በባሕሩ ሁሉም ለሙሴ ተጠመቁ፤ በዚህም እርሱን እንደ መሪያቸው ተከተሉ። \v 3 ሁሉም እግዚአብሔር የሰጣቸውን ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ ምግብ በሉ፤ \v 4 ሁሉም ያንኑ መንፈሳዊ መጠጥ ጠጡ። ከእነርሱ ጋር አብሮ ከሚሄደው ከመንፈሳዊው ዓለት ጠጡ፤ ያም ዓለት {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነበረ።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं नहीं चाहता कि तुम इस बात से अनजान रहो कि हमारे सब बापदादे बादल के नीचे थे, और सब समुद्र में से होकर पार गए, \v 2 और सब ने बादल में और समुद्र में मूसा में बपतिस्मा लिया, \v 3 और सब ने एक ही आत्मिक भोजन खाया, \v 4 और सब ने एक ही आत्मिक जल पिया; क्योंकि वे उस आत्मिक चट्टान से पीते रहे जो [उनके] साथ-साथ चलती थी, और वह चट्टान मसीह था।
hi.B: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम यह बात समझ लो: हमारे सब पूर्वज बादल के नीचे थे, और वे सब के सब समुद्र में से होकर निकले। \v 2 उन सब ने बादल में और समुद्र में मूसा में बपतिस्मा लिया। \v 3 उन सब ने एक ही आत्मिक भोजन खाया, \v 4 और उन सब ने एक ही आत्मिक जल पिया। वे उस आत्मिक चट्टान से पीते थे जो उनके साथ-साथ चलती थी, और वह चट्टान मसीह था।
hi.R: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम जानो कि हमारे पूर्वजों, यानी इस्राएल के लोगों, के साथ क्या हुआ जब मूसा उन्हें मिस्र से निकालकर ले गए। परमेश्वर की उपस्थिति का बादल उन सब के ऊपर था, और वे सब समुद्र में से होकर चले। \v 2 बादल में और समुद्र में उन सब ने मूसा में बपतिस्मा लिया, और इस तरह वे अपने अगुवे मूसा से जुड़ गए। \v 3 उन सब ने वही आत्मिक भोजन खाया जो परमेश्वर ने उन्हें दिया, \v 4 और उन सब ने वही आत्मिक जल पिया। वे उस आत्मिक चट्टान से पीते थे जो उनके साथ-साथ चलती थी, और वह चट्टान मसीह था।

ru.L: Ведь не хочу, чтобы вы не знали, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, что отцы наши все были под облаком и все прошли через море, \v 2 и все крестились в Моисея в облаке и в море, \v 3 и все ели одну и ту же духовную пищу, \v 4 и все пили одно и то же духовное питьё; ведь они пили из духовной скалы, следовавшей [за ними], а скала была {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}.
ru.B: Я хочу, чтобы вы поняли, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}: все наши предки до одного были под облаком, и все до одного прошли через море. \v 2 Все они были крещены в Моисея в облаке и в море. \v 3 Все они ели одну и ту же духовную пищу, \v 4 и все пили одно и то же духовное питьё. Они пили из духовной скалы, которая шла вместе с ними, и этой скалой был {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}.
ru.R: {{gender:Братья и сёстры|Братья}}, я хочу, чтобы вы знали, что произошло с нашими предками, народом Израиля, когда Моисей выводил их из Египта. Облако, в котором был Бог, было над всеми ними, и все они прошли через море. \v 2 В облаке и в море все они были крещены в Моисея и так соединились с ним как со своим вождём. \v 3 Все они ели одну и ту же духовную пищу, которую давал им Бог, \v 4 и все пили одно и то же духовное питьё. Они пили из духовной скалы, которая шла вместе с ними, и эта скала была {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}.

uk.L: Бо не хочу, щоб ви не знали, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, що наші батьки всі були під хмарою, і всі пройшли крізь море, \v 2 і всі хрестилися в Мойсея в хмарі й у морі, \v 3 і всі їли ту саму духовну їжу, \v 4 і всі пили той самий духовний напій; бо пили з духовної скелі, що йшла [за ними], а скеля була {{christos:Христос|Месія}}.
uk.B: Бо я хочу, щоб ви збагнули ось що, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}: усі наші предки до одного були під хмарою, і всі до одного пройшли крізь море. \v 2 Усі вони хрестилися в Мойсея в хмарі й у морі. \v 3 Усі вони їли ту саму духовну їжу, \v 4 і всі вони пили той самий духовний напій. Вони пили з духовної скелі, яка йшла разом з ними, і ця скеля була {{christos:Христос|Месія}}.
uk.R: {{gender:Брати і сестри|Брати}}, я хочу, щоб ви знали, що сталося з нашими предками, ізраїльським народом, коли Мойсей вивів їх з Єгипту. Хмара Божої присутності була над усіма ними, і всі вони пройшли крізь море. \v 2 У хмарі й у морі всі вони хрестилися в Мойсея, і так були зʼєднані з ним як зі своїм провідником. \v 3 Усі вони їли ту саму духовну їжу, яку дав їм Бог, \v 4 і всі вони пили той самий духовний напій. Вони пили з духовної скелі, яка йшла разом з ними, і ця скеля була {{christos:Христос|Месія}}.

ja.L: というのは、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしはあなたがたに知らないでいてほしくないのです。わたしたちの父祖たちは皆、雲の下にいて、皆、海を通り抜け、\v 2 皆、雲の中と海の中で、モーセへと洗礼を受け、\v 3 皆、同じ霊的な食べ物を食べ、\v 4 皆、同じ霊的な飲み物を飲みました。彼らは、ついて来る霊的な岩から飲み続けていたのです。そして、その岩は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}でした。
ja.B: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、あなたがたにぜひ知っておいてほしいことがあります。わたしたちの先祖は一人残らず雲の下にあり、一人残らず海を通り抜けました。\v 2 皆、雲の中と海の中で、モーセに結ばれる洗礼を受けました。\v 3 皆、同じ霊的な食べ物を食べ、\v 4 皆、同じ霊的な飲み物を飲みました。彼らは、共に進んで行く霊的な岩から飲んでいたのです。そして、その岩こそ{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}でした。
ja.R: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちの先祖であるイスラエルの人々に起こったことを、みなさんに知ってほしいのです。モーセがイスラエルの人々をエジプトから連れ出したとき、神がそこにおられることを示す雲が、みんなの上にありました。そして、みんなが海の中を歩いて渡りました。\v 2 雲の中と海の中で、みんながモーセへと洗礼を受け、モーセを指導者として結ばれたのです。\v 3 みんなが、神が与えてくださった同じ霊的な食べ物を食べました。\v 4 そして、みんなが同じ霊的な飲み物を飲みました。彼らは、いっしょについて来る霊的な岩から飲んでいたのです。その岩とは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}だったのです。

decisions.choice: for: the story of Israel backs up the warning at the end of chapter 9
alternatives: a loose link marking a new subject
decisions.reason: In 9:24-27 Paul warns that a runner can lose the prize, and that he disciplines himself so that he will not be disqualified. γὰρ introduces the proof: Israel had every privilege, and still most of them fell (verse 5).

decisions.choice: under the cloud ... through the sea: the cloud that led Israel out of Egypt and the crossing of the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Exodus 13:21-22 and 14:19-22 tell of the pillar of cloud that went with the people and stood between them and the Egyptians, and of the sea that God divided so that they crossed on dry ground. Psalm 105:39 speaks of the cloud spread over them.

decisions.choice: baptized into Moses: by passing under the cloud and through the water, Israel was joined to Moses as its leader, as believers are joined to Christ in baptism
alternatives: only a figure of speech with no link to Christian baptism
decisions.reason: No Israelite was immersed: they crossed on dry ground. Paul describes the Exodus in the language of Christian baptism ("baptized into Christ", Romans 6:3; Galatians 3:27; compare 1:13 here) to show that Israel had its own version of the church's privileges. The point is the warning: those privileges did not protect them.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: ἐβαπτίσαντο, the middle form ("they had themselves baptized" or simply "were baptized")
alternatives: the passive form ("were baptized"), found in other manuscripts
decisions.reason: Both forms are well attested in the manuscripts and the sense is the same: "were baptized". The SBLGNT text governs. The evidence here is described from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: spiritual: given by God through his Spirit, and pointing beyond itself to what believers receive
alternatives: symbolic only, not real food and drink
decisions.reason: The food was the manna (Exodus 16; Psalm 78:24-25) and the drink was the water from the rock (Exodus 17:1-7; Numbers 20:2-13): real food and water, but given by God in a way that went beyond nature. πνευματικὸν is the word Paul uses for what comes from the Spirit (2:13-15). The food and drink point ahead to the bread and cup of the Lord's Supper (verses 16-17).

decisions.choice: a rock that followed them: the rock that gave water at the start and the end of the wilderness journey, which Paul pictures as going with Israel
alternatives: a rock that only stood in one place
decisions.reason: Water came from a rock near the start of the journey (Exodus 17:6) and again near its end (Numbers 20:7-11). Later Jewish writings tell of a well that went with Israel through the wilderness. Paul's "followed" may draw on that story, but his point is not the legend: the source of their drink was always with them.

decisions.choice: the rock was Christ: Christ himself was present with Israel in the wilderness, giving them drink
alternatives: the rock represented or pictured Christ
decisions.reason: The verb is "was", in the past: Paul does not say the rock "stands for" Christ. In the Song of Moses God is called "the Rock" of Israel (Deuteronomy 32:4, 15, 18, 30-31). Paul names Christ as that Rock, present and active before he came as a man (compare 8:6, where all things exist through him). Verse 9 draws the consequence: Israel could put Christ to the test.

decisions.choice: our fathers: Israel's ancestors are the ancestors of believers, Gentiles included
alternatives: the ancestors of Jewish believers only
decisions.reason: Most of the Corinthian church had been pagans (12:2), yet Paul calls the wilderness generation "our fathers". Those who belong to Christ share Israel's story (compare Galatians 3:7, 29).

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί addresses the whole church, women and men (terms doc).

decisions.choice: every one of ... All of them (B); all of them (R)
decisions.reason: Paul says "all" five times: every Israelite had the privileges, yet most fell (verse 5). Balanced and Readable make the repetition heard.

decisions.choice: ancestors (B, R); fathers (L)
decisions.reason: The word means the earlier generations of the people, men and women alike. "Ancestors" says that plainly, as in John 6:31.

decisions.choice: the people of Israel, when Moses led them out of Egypt; The cloud of God's presence; joined to him as their leader; that God gave them
decisions.reason: Readable names the people and the event, and explains "baptized into Moses" (m3) and "spiritual" (m5).

decisions.choice: passé composé at every level for Israel's story in 10:1-11 ("ont été", "ont traversé", "ont mangé"); imperfect for the ongoing past ("ils buvaient")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, as in Hebrews 11
decisions.reason: Paul retells Israel's history to his readers to warn them (m1), as an argument and not as a narrative of its own, and the style guide puts retellings of history inside speech in the passé composé, as in the speeches of Acts. The passé simple is kept only for the narrative words quoted from Exodus in 10:7, at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 1:10 and through the letter, Spanish "hermanos" already includes the sisters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart; the same wherever "hermanos" returns in chapters 10-13.

decisions.choice: padres (L); antepasados (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "padres", the Greek word; Balanced and Readable say "antepasados", since "nuestros padres" in Spanish would be heard as one's own parents.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: As 1:10 and 8:11: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the English gender spans in chapters 10-13 have no Swahili counterpart; nor do those on "mtu", "yeyote" and the verb prefix a-, which already mean he or she.

decisions.choice: walibatizwa katika Musa (L); walibatizwa wakawa wa Musa (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kwa Musa" could mean "by Moses"; Balanced and Readable say what "into" means here, that Israel came to belong to Moses as its leader (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "các tổ phụ" (L); "tổ tiên" (B, R) for "our fathers"
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Romans 11:28 and 15:8.

decisions.choice: "chịu báp-têm vào Môi-se" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek has the middle form (m4), which the Vietnamese Galatians 3:27 renders "chịu báp-têm vào"; Readable adds what it meant, as the English does. "Môi-se", "Ai Cập" as the style guide's names.

decisions.choice: "조상들" for the fathers at every level
decisions.reason: "조상" is the word of Romans 9:5 and 11:28 for Israel's fathers; the meaning decision notes that they are the ancestors of believers, Gentiles included.

decisions.choice: "그 바위는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이셨습니다", with the past tense and the honorific at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verb "was" as it stands: Christ himself was present with Israel, not a picture of him.

decisions.choice: os nossos antepassados (B, R); os nossos pais (L)
decisions.reason: "Pais" in Portuguese can mean parents; "antepassados" says plainly that the earlier generations of the people are meant, men and women alike, as the English says "ancestors".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for God and for Christ are written plainly through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "ለሙሴ ተጠመቁ" (were baptized to Moses)
decisions.reason: "ወደ" is movement toward a place and would read oddly; "ለ" says they were baptized so as to belong to Moses as their leader (m3), as Christians are baptized to belong to Christ. "In Moses' name" would add words the Greek does not have.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: Paul addresses the whole church, women and men, so the inclusive vocative is the default and "भाइयो" the alternative, as in Romans and 1 Corinthians 1.

decisions.choice: no christos span
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the name and the word Messiah, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: "बापदादे" (L); "पूर्वज" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The fathers are the earlier generations of the people, women and men (meaning decision m8). Literal uses "बापदादे", the word Acts uses for Israel's fathers; Balanced and Readable say "पूर्वज", which is plainly inclusive.

decisions.choice: "वह चट्टान मसीह था"
decisions.reason: The verb agrees with the rock as the subject of the statement; honorific "थे" would make Christ the subject and turn the identification round.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}
decisions.reason: Paul addresses the whole church, women and men; the key-term span used through Paul's letters.

decisions.choice: предки (B, R); отцы (L)
decisions.reason: The word means the earlier generations of the people, men and women alike; "предки" says that plainly, as in John 6:31.

decisions.choice: батьки (L); предки (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps "fathers", Balanced and Readable say "ancestors". "Отці" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: хрестилися в Мойсея
decisions.reason: The Greek middle form (m4) is closer to the Ukrainian reflexive "хреститися" than to a passive, and it matches "хрестилися" in 1:13-15.

decisions.choice: "父祖たち" (L); "先祖" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Israel's ancestors, claimed as the believers' own (m8); "父たち" would read as literal fathers.

decisions.choice: "モーセへと洗礼を受け" (L, R); "モーセに結ばれる洗礼を受けました" (B)
alternatives: "モーセの名によって洗礼を受け"
decisions.reason: Being joined to Moses as leader, as believers to Christ (m3); Balanced says what "into" means.

source.text: ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν ηὐδόκησεν ὁ θεός, κατεστρώθησαν γὰρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.

records.literal_gloss: But not with the most of them was well pleased the God, they were strewn for in the wilderness.

en.L: But with most of them God was not well pleased, for they were strewn [dead] in the wilderness.
en.B: Yet God took no pleasure in most of them, for the wilderness was strewn with their bodies.
en.R: But most of them did not please God. They died in the desert, and their bodies were left lying there.

fr.L: Mais ce n’est pas en la plupart d’entre eux que Dieu a pris plaisir, car ils ont été étendus [morts] dans le désert.
fr.B: Pourtant, Dieu n’a pas pris plaisir à la plupart d’entre eux, car leurs corps ont jonché le désert.
fr.R: Mais la plupart d’entre eux n’ont pas plu à Dieu. Ils sont morts dans le désert, et leurs corps sont restés étendus là.

es.L: Pero en la mayoría de ellos no se complació Dios, porque quedaron tendidos [muertos] en el desierto.
es.B: Sin embargo, Dios no se complació en la mayoría de ellos, y sus cuerpos quedaron esparcidos por el desierto.
es.R: Pero la mayoría de ellos no agradó a Dios. Murieron en el desierto, y sus cuerpos quedaron tirados allí.

sw.L: Lakini Mungu hakupendezwa na wengi wao, kwa maana walitapakazwa [wakiwa wafu] nyikani.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, Mungu hakupendezwa na wengi wao, kwa maana miili yao ilitapakaa kote nyikani.
sw.R: Lakini wengi wao hawakumpendeza Mungu. Walifia jangwani, na miili yao ikabaki imelala huko.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời không hài lòng với phần đông trong số họ, vì họ đã bị ngã rạp trong hoang mạc.
vi.B: Thế nhưng Đức Chúa Trời không vui lòng về phần đông trong số họ, vì xác họ đã nằm la liệt trong hoang mạc.
vi.R: Nhưng phần đông trong số họ đã không làm đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời. Họ đã chết trong sa mạc, và xác họ bị bỏ lại nằm đó.

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께서는 그들 대부분을 기뻐하지 않으셨습니다. 그들이 광야에서 쓰러져 [죽었기] 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서는 그들 대부분을 기뻐하지 않으셨습니다. 그래서 광야에는 그들의 시체가 널려 있었습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들 대부분은 하나님을 기쁘시게 하지 못했습니다. 그들은 광야에서 죽었고, 그들의 시체가 거기 그대로 남았습니다.

pt.L: Mas com a maioria deles Deus não se agradou, pois foram prostrados [mortos] no deserto.
pt.B: Mas Deus não se agradou da maior parte deles, pois o deserto ficou coberto com os seus corpos.
pt.R: Mas a maioria deles não agradou a Deus. Eles morreram no deserto, e os seus corpos ficaram espalhados por lá.

am.L: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ከእነርሱ በብዙዎቹ ደስ አላለውም፤ በምድረ በዳ ተረፍርፈው ወድቀዋልና።
am.B: ይሁን እንጂ እግዚአብሔር በአብዛኞቹ ደስ አልተሰኘም፤ ምድረ በዳው በሬሳቸው ተሞልቶ ነበርና።
am.R: ነገር ግን አብዛኞቹ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አላሰኙም። በምድረ በዳ ሞቱ፤ ሬሳቸውም በዚያው ወድቆ ቀረ።

hi.L: पर परमेश्वर उनमें से अधिकांश से प्रसन्न न हुए, क्योंकि वे निर्जन प्रदेश में ढेर हो गए।
hi.B: फिर भी परमेश्वर उनमें से अधिकतर से प्रसन्न नहीं थे, क्योंकि निर्जन प्रदेश में उनकी लाशें बिछ गईं।
hi.R: पर उनमें से ज़्यादातर लोगों ने परमेश्वर को प्रसन्न नहीं किया। वे सुनसान इलाक़े में मर गए, और उनकी लाशें वहीं पड़ी रहीं।

ru.L: Но не о большинстве из них благоволил Бог, ведь они были повержены в пустыне.
ru.B: Но большинство из них не было угодно Богу: их тела усеяли пустыню.
ru.R: Но большинство из них не угодили Богу. Они умерли в пустыне, и их тела остались лежать там.

uk.L: Але більшість із них не була до вподоби Богові, бо вони полягли в пустелі.
uk.B: Однак більшість із них не була Богові до вподоби, бо пустеля вкрилася їхніми тілами.
uk.R: Але більшість із них не догодили Богові. Вони померли в пустелі, і їхні тіла залишилися лежати там.

ja.L: しかし、彼らの大部分を神は喜ばれませんでした。彼らは荒れ野で[死んで]散らされたからです。
ja.B: しかし、神は彼らの大部分をお喜びになりませんでした。荒れ野には彼らのしかばねが散らばったのです。
ja.R: でも、彼らのほとんどは、神に喜ばれませんでした。彼らは荒れ野で死に、そのしかばねは、そこに倒れたままになりました。

decisions.choice: strewn in the wilderness: the death of the whole adult generation in the wilderness, as God had said
decisions.reason: In Numbers 14:16 and 14:29-35 God says that the bodies of those who refused to enter the land will fall in the wilderness. κατεστρώθησαν is the verb of Numbers 14:16 in the Greek Old Testament. Of the adults who left Egypt only Joshua and Caleb entered the land.

decisions.choice: not with most of them: an understatement; almost all of them
decisions.reason: "Not ... most" is a restrained way of saying that nearly the whole generation came under God's judgment (Numbers 14:29-30).

decisions.choice: for: their death in the wilderness shows that God was not pleased with them
decisions.reason: γὰρ gives the evidence for the first clause, not its cause.

decisions.choice: the wilderness was strewn with their bodies
alternatives: they were struck down in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of the verb, bodies scattered across the ground, and turns it round so that the sentence reads naturally.

decisions.choice: desert
decisions.reason: Readable uses the common word; the place was dry, empty land.

decisions.choice: desierto
decisions.reason: Spanish "desierto" is the usual word for the wilderness of Israel's journey, as in the Gospels, so every level uses it; "yermo" is rare today.

decisions.choice: "광야" at every level
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "desert"; Korean "광야" (wilderness) is the plain word of the Gospels for the land Israel crossed, and it is understood by young readers.

decisions.choice: o deserto (every level)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "deserto" is the ordinary word for the dry, empty land of Israel's wandering and is already the familiar name of these years; English needs "wilderness" and "desert" at different levels, Portuguese does not.

decisions.choice: "निर्जन प्रदेश" (L, B); "सुनसान इलाक़ा" (R)
decisions.reason: The wilderness term settled in Matthew (style guide section 7b); "जंगल" would mean forest.

source.text: Ταῦτα δὲ τύποι ἡμῶν ἐγενήθησαν, εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν, καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν.

records.literal_gloss: These things now examples of us became, for the not to be us desirers of evil things, as those also desired.

en.L: Now these things became examples for us, so that we would not be people who desire evil things, as they also desired.
en.B: These events became examples for us, warning us not to crave what is evil, as they craved it.
en.R: What happened to them is a warning for us. We must not long for evil things the way they did.

fr.L: Or ces choses sont devenues des exemples pour nous, afin que nous ne soyons pas des gens qui désirent des choses mauvaises, comme eux aussi [en] ont désiré.
fr.B: Ces événements sont devenus des exemples pour nous : ils nous avertissent de ne pas convoiter le mal, comme eux l’ont convoité.
fr.R: Ce qui leur est arrivé est un avertissement pour nous. Nous ne devons pas désirer des choses mauvaises comme eux l’ont fait.

es.L: Ahora bien, estas cosas llegaron a ser ejemplos para nosotros, para que no seamos codiciosos de cosas malas, como también aquellos codiciaron.
es.B: Estos hechos se convirtieron en ejemplos para nosotros, para advertirnos que no codiciemos lo malo, como ellos lo codiciaron.
es.R: Lo que les pasó a ellos es una advertencia para nosotros. No debemos desear cosas malas como ellos las desearon.

sw.L: Basi mambo haya yalikuwa mifano kwetu, ili sisi tusiwe watu wa kutamani mambo maovu, kama wao nao walivyotamani.
sw.B: Matukio haya yakawa mifano kwetu, yakituonya tusitamani yaliyo maovu kama wao walivyotamani.
sw.R: Yaliyowapata ni onyo kwetu. Tusiwe na hamu ya mambo maovu kama wao walivyokuwa nayo.

vi.L: Những điều này đã trở nên gương cho chúng ta, để chúng ta không trở thành những người ham muốn điều ác, như họ đã ham muốn.
vi.B: Những biến cố ấy đã trở nên gương cho chúng ta, cảnh cáo chúng ta đừng thèm khát điều ác như họ đã thèm khát.
vi.R: Những gì đã xảy ra cho họ là một lời cảnh cáo cho chúng ta. Chúng ta không được khao khát những điều xấu xa như họ đã khao khát.

ko.L: 이 일들은 우리에게 본보기가 되었습니다. 그들이 악한 것을 탐냈던 것처럼 우리는 악한 것을 탐내는 사람이 되지 않게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이 일들은 우리에게 본보기가 되었습니다. 그들이 악한 것을 탐낸 것처럼 우리가 악한 것을 탐내지 않도록 경고하는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들에게 일어난 일은 우리에게 주는 경고입니다. 우리는 그들처럼 악한 것을 원해서는 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Ora, estas coisas se tornaram exemplos para nós, para que não sejamos pessoas que desejam coisas más, como também eles desejaram.
pt.B: Esses acontecimentos se tornaram exemplos para nós, para nos advertir a não cobiçar o que é mau, como eles cobiçaram.
pt.R: O que aconteceu com eles é uma advertência para nós. Não devemos desejar coisas más como eles desejaram.

am.L: እነዚህም ነገሮች ለእኛ ምሳሌዎች ሆኑ፤ ይኸውም እነዚያ ደግሞ እንደ ተመኙ፣ እኛ ክፉ ነገርን የምንመኝ እንዳንሆን ነው።
am.B: እነዚህ ነገሮች ለእኛ ምሳሌ ሆኑ፤ እነርሱ ክፉውን እንደ ተመኙ እኛ ክፉ ነገርን እንዳንመኝ ያስጠነቅቁናል።
am.R: በእነርሱ ላይ የሆነው ለእኛ ማስጠንቀቂያ ነው። እነርሱ እንዳደረጉት እኛ ክፉ ነገርን መመኘት የለብንም።

hi.L: पर ये बातें हमारे लिए उदाहरण बनीं, ताकि हम बुरी वस्तुओं की लालसा करनेवाले न बनें, जैसे उन्होंने भी लालसा की।
hi.B: ये घटनाएँ हमारे लिए उदाहरण बन गईं, जो हमें चेतावनी देती हैं कि हम बुराई की लालसा न करें, जैसे उन्होंने लालसा की।
hi.R: उनके साथ जो हुआ, वह हमारे लिए चेतावनी है। हमें बुरी चीज़ों की चाह नहीं करनी चाहिए, जैसे उन्होंने की।

ru.L: Это же стало примерами для нас, чтобы нам не быть желающими злого, как и те пожелали.
ru.B: Эти события стали для нас примерами, предостерегающими нас от того, чтобы жаждать зла, как жаждали они.
ru.R: То, что случилось с ними, — предупреждение для нас. Мы не должны желать плохого так, как они.

uk.L: А це стало прикладами для нас, щоб ми не були охочими до злого, як і ті були охочі.
uk.B: Ці події стали для нас прикладами й застереженням, щоб ми не прагнули злого, як прагнули вони.
uk.R: Те, що сталося з ними, — це застереження для нас. Ми не повинні жадати злого так, як жадали вони.

ja.L: さて、これらのことは、わたしたちのための手本となりました。彼らが欲したように、わたしたちが悪いものを欲する者とならないためです。
ja.B: これらの出来事は、わたしたちへの戒めの手本となりました。彼らがむさぼったように、わたしたちが悪いものをむさぼることのないためです。
ja.R: 彼らに起こったことは、わたしたちへの警告です。わたしたちは、彼らのように悪いものを欲しがってはいけません。

decisions.choice: examples: events that serve as patterns and warnings for the church
alternatives: types in a technical sense, events that predict later ones
decisions.reason: τύποι is a mark left by a blow, then a pattern or model. Here what happened to Israel is a pattern that God intended to speak to the church, and in this passage it speaks as a warning. Verse 11 says the same with the adverb τυπικῶς.

decisions.choice: for us: for our benefit, as a lesson aimed at us
alternatives: examples of us, that is, pictures of what we are
decisions.reason: The genitive ἡμῶν is best taken as "for us", as verse 11 says plainly: "written down to warn us".

decisions.choice: they craved: the people's craving for meat in the wilderness
decisions.reason: In Numbers 11:4-34 the people crave meat, and the place where they were buried is named "Graves of Craving". This craving heads a list of five sins (verses 6-10); the first and last echo the Corinthians' own appetite for temple meals.

decisions.choice: examples ... warning (B); a warning (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "examples" and makes their purpose explicit (m1); Readable says simply what they are for.

decisions.choice: crave ... craved (B); long for (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats the verb as the Greek repeats the root, and "crave" recalls the craving for meat in Numbers 11 (m3).

decisions.choice: codiciar
decisions.reason: The verb is a craving (m3). "Codiciar" says a strong wrong desire, and is kept for both the noun and the verb at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "desear".

decisions.choice: "본보기" (L, B); "경고" (R), here and in verse 11
decisions.reason: "모형" is the word of Romans 5:14 for Adam as a pattern; here the events serve as warnings, which "본보기" says in everyday Korean.

decisions.choice: cobiçar ... cobiçaram
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats one verb as the Greek repeats the root; "cobiçar" is the strong Portuguese word for a craving that ought not to be fed, which recalls the craving for meat in Numbers 11 (m3).

decisions.choice: "手本" (L); "戒めの手本" (B); "警告" (R)
decisions.reason: Events that serve as patterns and warnings (m1); "型" is the technical word but would puzzle a reader here.

source.text: μηδὲ εἰδωλολάτραι γίνεσθε, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν· ὥσπερ γέγραπται· Ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.

records.literal_gloss: Neither idolaters become, as some of them; as it has been written: Sat the people to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

en.L: Do not become idolaters either, as some of them [were]; as it is written, "The people sat to eat and to drink, and they rose up to play."
en.B: Do not become idolaters, as some of them did. Scripture says, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and then rose to make merry."
en.R: Do not worship idols, as some of them did. The Scriptures say, "The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up and celebrated with wild dancing."

fr.L: Ne devenez pas non plus idolâtres, comme certains d’entre eux [l’ont été], ainsi qu’il est écrit : « Le peuple s’assit pour manger et boire, et ils se levèrent pour s’amuser. »
fr.B: Ne devenez pas idolâtres, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont été. L’Écriture dit : « Le peuple s’assit pour manger et boire, puis ils se levèrent pour faire la fête. »
fr.R: N’adorez pas d’idoles, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait. Les Écritures disent : « Le peuple s’est assis pour manger et boire. Ensuite, ils se sont levés et ils ont fait la fête en dansant sans retenue. »

es.L: Ni {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} idólatras, como algunos de ellos; según está escrito: «Se sentó el pueblo a comer y a beber, y se levantaron a divertirse».
es.B: No {{plural_you:se hagan|os hagáis}} idólatras, como lo hicieron algunos de ellos. La Escritura dice: «El pueblo se sentó a comer y a beber, y luego se levantó a hacer fiesta».
es.R: No {{plural_you:adoren|adoréis}} ídolos, como hicieron algunos de ellos. Las Escrituras dicen: «La gente se sentó a comer y a beber. Luego se levantaron y celebraron con bailes desenfrenados».

sw.L: Wala msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama baadhi yao [walivyokuwa]; kama ilivyoandikwa, "Watu waliketi kula na kunywa, nao wakainuka kucheza."
sw.B: Msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama baadhi yao walivyokuwa. Maandiko yanasema, "Watu waliketi kula na kunywa, kisha wakainuka kufanya sherehe."
sw.R: Msiabudu sanamu kama baadhi yao walivyofanya. Maandiko yanasema, "Watu waliketi kula na kunywa. Kisha wakainuka wakasherehekea kwa ngoma za fujo."

vi.L: Cũng đừng trở thành những kẻ thờ thần tượng như một số người trong họ; như có chép: "Dân chúng ngồi xuống ăn uống, rồi đứng dậy vui chơi."
vi.B: Đừng trở thành những người thờ thần tượng như một số người trong họ. Kinh Thánh có chép: "Dân chúng ngồi xuống ăn uống, rồi đứng dậy chơi đùa hội hè."
vi.R: Đừng thờ thần tượng như một số người trong họ đã làm. Kinh Thánh chép: "Dân chúng ngồi xuống ăn uống. Rồi họ đứng dậy nhảy múa cuồng loạn."

ko.L: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들처럼 우상을 숭배하는 사람이 되지 마십시오. 기록되어 있기를 "백성이 앉아서 먹고 마시고, 일어나서 놀았다" 하였습니다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들처럼 우상을 숭배하는 사람이 되지 마십시오. 성경에 "백성이 앉아서 먹고 마시고는 일어나 흥청거리며 놀았다" 했습니다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들처럼 우상을 섬기지 마십시오. 성경에 이렇게 쓰여 있습니다. "백성이 앉아서 먹고 마셨다. 그러고는 일어나서 마구 춤을 추며 즐겼다."

pt.L: Nem se tornem idólatras, como alguns deles [foram]; como está escrito: "O povo se sentou para comer e beber, e se levantou para se divertir."
pt.B: Não se tornem idólatras, como alguns deles se tornaram. A Escritura diz: "O povo se sentou para comer e beber, e depois se levantou para festejar."
pt.R: Não adorem ídolos, como alguns deles fizeram. As Escrituras dizem: "O povo se sentou para comer e beber. Depois se levantou e começou a festejar com danças descontroladas."

am.L: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ እንደ [ሆኑ] ጣዖት አምላኪዎች አትሁኑ፤ «ሕዝቡ ሊበሉና ሊጠጡ ተቀመጡ፣ ሊጫወቱም ተነሡ» ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።
am.B: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት ጣዖት አምላኪዎች አትሁኑ። መጽሐፍ «ሕዝቡ ሊበሉና ሊጠጡ ተቀመጡ፤ ከዚያም ሊፈነጥዙ ተነሡ» ይላል።
am.R: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት ጣዖትን አታምልኩ። መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ሕዝቡ ሊበሉና ሊጠጡ ተቀመጡ። ከዚያም ተነሥተው እየጨፈሩ ፈነጠዙ።»

hi.L: और न तुम मूर्तिपूजक बनो, जैसे उनमें से कुछ [बने]; जैसा लिखा है, "लोग खाने और पीने को बैठे, और खेलने को उठ खड़े हुए।"
hi.B: मूर्तिपूजक मत बनो, जैसे उनमें से कुछ बन गए। पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है, "लोग खाने-पीने बैठे, और फिर रंगरलियाँ मनाने उठे।"
hi.R: मूर्तियों की पूजा मत करो, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने की। पवित्रशास्त्र में लिखा है, "लोग खाने-पीने बैठ गए। फिर वे उठकर बेलगाम नाच-गाने में लग गए।"

ru.L: И не становитесь идолопоклонниками, как некоторые из них, как написано: «Сел народ есть и пить, и встали играть.»
ru.B: Не становитесь идолопоклонниками, как некоторые из них. Писание говорит: «Народ сел есть и пить, а потом встал веселиться.»
ru.R: Не поклоняйтесь идолам, как это делали некоторые из них. В Писании сказано: «Народ сел есть и пить. Потом они встали и стали праздновать с буйными плясками.»

uk.L: І не ставайте ідолопоклонниками, як деякі з них; як написано: «Сів народ їсти й пити, і встали гратися».
uk.B: Не ставайте ідолопоклонниками, як дехто з них. Писання каже: «Народ сів їсти й пити, а потім устав веселитися».
uk.R: Не поклоняйтеся ідолам, як дехто з них. Писання каже: «Люди сіли їсти й пити. Потім вони встали і почали дико танцювати й гуляти».

ja.L: 彼らのうちのある人たちのように、偶像礼拝者になってもいけません。次のように書かれているとおりです。「民は座って食べ、飲み、立ち上がって戯れた。」
ja.B: 彼らのうちのある人たちがなったように、偶像礼拝者になってはいけません。聖書にこう書かれています。「民は座って食べたり飲んだりし、それから立ち上がって浮かれ騒いだ。」
ja.R: 彼らのうちのある人たちのように、偶像を拝んではいけません。聖書には、こう書いてあります。「人々は座って食べたり飲んだりした。それから立ち上がり、偶像の前で踊って騒いだ。」

decisions.choice: a quotation of Exodus 32:6, the feast before the golden calf
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the Greek Old Testament of Exodus 32:6 word for word. The people made a golden calf, offered sacrifices to it, and then held a feast in its honor (Exodus 32:1-6, 17-19).

decisions.choice: eat and drink in honor of an idol: the same thing as the Corinthians' meals in idol temples
decisions.reason: Paul chooses the one verse that joins idolatry and a sacrificial meal. Those in Corinth who ate in an idol's temple (8:10) were doing what Israel did at Sinai.

decisions.choice: play: festive dancing and revelry in the idol's honor
decisions.reason: παίζειν is used in the Greek Old Testament for dancing and festivity, and in Exodus 32:19 Moses sees the calf and the dancing. Some read a sexual sense into it, which would lead into verse 8, but the text does not require it.

decisions.choice: do not become: a command to the Corinthians, after the "we" of verse 6
decisions.reason: Paul moves between "you" (verses 7, 10) and "let us" (verses 8-9), but the warnings are one series.

decisions.choice: make merry (B); celebrated with wild dancing (R)
decisions.reason: "Play" now suggests children's games. Balanced uses an older but clear word for festive celebration; Readable names the dancing (m3).

decisions.choice: Scripture says (B); The Scriptures say (R)
decisions.reason: The formula introduces a quotation from Scripture, so Balanced and Readable say so plainly.

decisions.choice: worship idols
decisions.reason: As in the vice lists of 5:10-11 and 6:9 (terms doc).

decisions.choice: "s'assit", "se levèrent" (L, B); "s'est assis", "se sont levés" (R)
alternatives: passé composé at every level, as in 10:1-11
decisions.reason: The quotation from Exodus 32:6 is a piece of narrative, so Literal and Balanced keep the narrative passé simple inside it, as Hebrews 4:4 does for Genesis; Paul's own words around it stay in the passé composé. Readable uses the passé composé throughout.

decisions.choice: divertirse (L); hacer fiesta (B); celebrar con bailes desenfrenados (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is festive dancing and revelry in the idol's honor (m3). "Jugar" in today's Spanish suggests children's games, so Literal says "divertirse" and Balanced and Readable say what the feast was.

decisions.choice: La Escritura dice (B); Las Escrituras dicen (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:19 and 3:19 of this letter: Literal keeps "está escrito", and Balanced and Readable say who speaks.

decisions.choice: kucheza (L); kufanya sherehe (B); wakasherehekea kwa ngoma za fujo (R)
decisions.reason: "Kucheza" is both to play and to dance, so Literal keeps the one word; Balanced and Readable name the revelry in the idol's honor (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "रंगरलियाँ मनाने" (B); "बेलगाम नाच-गाने में लग गए" (R)
decisions.reason: "Play" here is festive dancing and revelry in the idol's honor (meaning decision m3); "खेलना" would suggest games. Literal keeps "खेलने".

decisions.choice: веселиться (B); праздновать с буйными плясками (R)
decisions.reason: "Играть" now suggests children's games; the word means festive dancing and revelry in the idol's honour (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps "играть".

source.text: μηδὲ πορνεύωμεν, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ ἔπεσαν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ εἴκοσι τρεῖς χιλιάδες.

records.literal_gloss: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed sexual immorality, and fell in one day twenty three thousand.

en.L: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed sexual immorality, and 23,000 fell in one day.
en.B: Nor should we give ourselves to sexual immorality, which some of them practiced, and 23,000 fell dead in a single day.
en.R: We must not commit sexual sins, as some of them did. Because of that, 23,000 of them died in one day.

fr.L: Ne nous livrons pas non plus à l’immoralité sexuelle, comme certains d’entre eux s’y sont livrés, et il en est tombé 23 000 en un seul jour.
fr.B: Ne nous adonnons pas non plus à l’immoralité sexuelle, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait, et 23 000 sont tombés morts en un seul jour.
fr.R: Nous ne devons pas commettre de péchés sexuels, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait. À cause de cela, 23 000 d’entre eux sont morts en un seul jour.

es.L: Ni cometamos inmoralidad sexual, como algunos de ellos [la] cometieron, y cayeron en un solo día 23 000.
es.B: Tampoco nos entreguemos a la inmoralidad sexual, como lo hicieron algunos de ellos, y en un solo día cayeron muertos 23 000.
es.R: No debemos cometer pecados sexuales, como hicieron algunos de ellos. Por eso murieron 23 000 de ellos en un solo día.

sw.L: Wala tusifanye uasherati, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya uasherati, wakaanguka watu 23,000 katika siku moja.
sw.B: Tusijitie katika uasherati, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakaanguka wakafa watu 23,000 katika siku moja.
sw.R: Tusifanye dhambi za ngono kama baadhi yao walivyofanya. Kwa sababu hiyo, watu 23,000 kati yao walikufa katika siku moja.

vi.L: Chúng ta cũng đừng phạm tội tà dâm, như một số người trong họ đã phạm tội tà dâm, và trong một ngày hai mươi ba nghìn người đã ngã chết.
vi.B: Chúng ta cũng đừng buông mình vào sự tà dâm như một số người trong họ đã làm, và chỉ trong một ngày đã có hai mươi ba nghìn người ngã chết.
vi.R: Chúng ta không được phạm tội tình dục như một số người trong họ đã làm. Vì điều đó mà trong một ngày có hai mươi ba nghìn người trong số họ đã chết.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들이 음행하다가 하루에 이만 삼천 명이 쓰러진 것처럼, 우리도 음행하지 맙시다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들이 음행에 빠졌다가 하루에 이만 삼천 명이 쓰러져 죽었습니다. 우리는 그런 음행에 빠지지 맙시다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들은 성적인 죄를 지었습니다. 그 때문에 하루에 이만 삼천 명이 죽었습니다. 우리는 그런 죄를 짓지 맙시다.

pt.L: Nem pratiquemos imoralidade sexual, como alguns deles praticaram imoralidade sexual, e caíram num só dia vinte e três mil.
pt.B: Também não devemos nos entregar à imoralidade sexual, como alguns deles fizeram, e num só dia caíram mortos vinte e três mil.
pt.R: Não devemos cometer pecados sexuais, como alguns deles fizeram. Por causa disso, vinte e três mil deles morreram num só dia.

am.L: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ እንደ ሴሰኑ አንሴስን፤ በአንድ ቀንም 23,000 ወደቁ።
am.B: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት ራሳችንን ለዝሙት አንስጥ፤ በአንድ ቀን 23,000 ሰዎች ሞተው ወደቁ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት የዝሙት ኃጢአት መፈጸም የለብንም። በዚህም የተነሣ በአንድ ቀን ከእነርሱ 23,000 ሞቱ።

hi.L: और न हम यौन अनैतिकता करें, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने यौन अनैतिकता की, और एक ही दिन में 23,000 गिर पड़े।
hi.B: हम यौन पाप में न पड़ें, जैसा उनमें से कुछ ने किया, और एक ही दिन में 23,000 मरकर गिर पड़े।
hi.R: हमें यौन पाप नहीं करना चाहिए, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने किया। इसी कारण उनमें से 23,000 लोग एक ही दिन में मर गए।

ru.L: И не будем блудить, как некоторые из них блудили, и пали в один день 23 000.
ru.B: Не будем предаваться распутству, как это делали некоторые из них, — и в один день погибло 23 000.
ru.R: Мы не должны совершать сексуальных грехов, как это делали некоторые из них. Из-за этого 23 000 из них умерли в один день.

uk.L: І не чинімо розпусти, як деякі з них чинили розпусту, і полягло за один день двадцять три тисячі.
uk.B: І не віддаваймося розпусті, яку чинили деякі з них, і за один день упало мертвими двадцять три тисячі.
uk.R: Ми не повинні чинити статевих гріхів, як дехто з них. Через це за один день померли двадцять три тисячі з них.

ja.L: また、わたしたちは淫らな行いをしないようにしましょう。彼らのうちのある人たちは淫らな行いをし、一日に二万三千人が倒れました。
ja.B: また、彼らのうちのある人たちがしたように、淫らな行いにふけることのないようにしましょう。彼らは一日で二万三千人も倒れて死んだのです。
ja.R: わたしたちは、彼らのうちのある人たちのように、性的な罪を犯してはいけません。そのために、彼らは一日で二万三千人も死んだのです。

decisions.choice: Israel at Peor: sexual sin with Moabite women that led to the worship of their god
decisions.reason: In Numbers 25:1-9 Israelite men had sex with Moabite women, who invited them to the sacrifices of their gods; the people ate and bowed down to Baal of Peor, and a plague followed. Idolatry, sacrificial meals and sexual sin came together, as they could at Corinthian temple feasts (compare 6:12-20).

decisions.choice: twenty-three thousand: Numbers 25:9 gives twenty-four thousand
decisions.reason: Paul's number is one thousand lower than Numbers 25:9. He may be giving a round figure from memory, or counting only those who died "in one day". Exodus 32:28 tells of three thousand who died after the golden calf, and some think Paul's figure combines the two stories. The text does not explain the difference.

decisions.choice: commit sexual immorality: any sexual relationship outside marriage
decisions.reason: The verb belongs with πορνεύω's noun, sexual immorality (5:1; 6:13, 18).

decisions.choice: let us: Paul includes himself in the warning
decisions.reason: The first person plural shows that no one is above the warning, Paul included (9:27).
Numbers above ninety-nine are written in figures (style guide).

decisions.choice: Because of that
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the deaths were God's judgment on their sin (Numbers 25:9).

decisions.choice: give ourselves to sexual immorality, which some of them practiced
alternatives: commit sexual immorality, as some of them did
decisions.reason: Balanced avoids repeating the verb and keeps "sexual immorality" (terms doc); Readable says "sexual sins".

decisions.choice: 23 000, in figures with a thin space
decisions.reason: As in English, numbers above one hundred are written in figures (style guide 4); French separates thousands with a narrow no-break space, not a comma.
Spanish writes the number in figures with a space for thousands, as the Spanish of this project does (Revelation 7:4, "144 000").

decisions.choice: watu 23,000
decisions.reason: A large count in figures, with the comma for thousands as the project writes Swahili numbers; "watu" supplies the noun Swahili needs with a bare number (in Literal it is not bracketed, as the number already implies people).

decisions.choice: "hai mươi ba nghìn" in words
decisions.reason: The style guide writes numbers in running text in words; "nghìn" as in the Vietnamese Romans 11:4.

decisions.choice: "-지 맙시다" for "let us not", Paul including himself, in verses 8-9
decisions.reason: The polite "let us" of 합쇼체, as in 5:8.

decisions.choice: vinte e três mil
decisions.reason: Portuguese writes a round number like this in words in running text (style guide §5), where the English uses figures.

decisions.choice: "መሴሰን" (commit sexual immorality) at Literal; "ዝሙት" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek's verb with a verb, "ሴሰነ", which covers any sexual sin (m3); "ማመንዘር" is adultery only. Balanced and Readable use the noun "ዝሙት", the chapter 6 and 7 word.

decisions.choice: "यौन अनैतिकता" (L); "यौन पाप" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb covers any sexual relationship outside marriage (meaning decision m3). The terms settled for porneia in 1 Corinthians 5-7: "यौन अनैतिकता" at Literal, "यौन पाप" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: блудить (L); предаваться распутству (B); совершать сексуальных грехов (R)
decisions.reason: Porneia is any sexual relationship outside marriage (meaning decision m3), not only adultery. Literal keeps the Bible word "блуд", Balanced says "распутство" and Readable says it in everyday words, as in 5:9-11.

decisions.choice: двадцять три тисячі, in words
decisions.reason: The English writes the figure. Ukrainian running text spells out a round number like this one, as the style guide asks for short numbers; the figure is kept for longer ones.

decisions.choice: "二万三千人" in kanji numerals
decisions.reason: Kanji numerals in running text (style 5); the figure stays as the Greek has it (m2).

source.text: μηδὲ ἐκπειράζωμεν τὸν Χριστόν, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπείρασαν, καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ὄφεων ἀπώλλυντο.

records.literal_gloss: Neither let us put to the test the Christ, as some of them tested, and by the serpents they were being destroyed.

en.L: Neither let us put the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} to the test, as some of them tested [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], and they were destroyed by the serpents.
en.B: Nor should we try the patience of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, as some of them tried it; they were killed off by the snakes, one after another.
en.R: We must not try to see how far we can push {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, as some of them did. Snakes bit them, and they died.

fr.L: Ne mettons pas non plus le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} à l’épreuve, comme certains d’entre eux [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]ont mis à l’épreuve, et ils étaient détruits par les serpents.
fr.B: Ne poussons pas non plus à bout la patience du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait ; ils ont été tués par les serpents, les uns après les autres.
fr.R: Nous ne devons pas provoquer le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour voir jusqu’où nous pouvons aller, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait. Des serpents les ont mordus, et ils sont morts.

es.L: Ni pongamos a prueba al {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, como algunos de ellos [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] pusieron a prueba, y eran destruidos por las serpientes.
es.B: Tampoco pongamos a prueba la paciencia {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, como algunos de ellos lo hicieron; y las serpientes los fueron matando uno tras otro.
es.R: No debemos poner a prueba {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} para ver hasta dónde aguanta, como hicieron algunos de ellos. Las serpientes los mordieron, y murieron.

sw.L: Wala tusimjaribu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kama baadhi yao walivyomjaribu, nao wakawa wakiangamizwa na nyoka.
sw.B: Wala tusiijaribu subira ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kama baadhi yao walivyoijaribu; waliuawa na nyoka mmoja baada ya mwingine.
sw.R: Tusimjaribu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ili tuone atatuvumilia kwa kiasi gani, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya. Nyoka waliwauma, wakafa.

vi.L: Chúng ta cũng đừng thử {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, như một số người trong họ đã thử [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}], và đã bị rắn giết chết.
vi.B: Chúng ta cũng đừng thử thách lòng nhẫn nại của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, như một số người trong họ đã làm; và họ đã lần lượt bị rắn cắn chết.
vi.R: Chúng ta không được thử xem mình có thể thách thức {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đến mức nào, như một số người trong họ đã làm. Rắn đã cắn họ, và họ chết.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들이 [그분을] 시험하다가 뱀에게 멸망한 것처럼, 우리도 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 시험하지 맙시다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 시험하다가 뱀에게 물려 하나씩 죽어 갔습니다. 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 시험하지 맙시다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 어디까지 참으시는지 시험해 보다가 뱀에게 물려 죽었습니다. 우리는 그런 일을 하지 맙시다.

pt.L: Nem ponhamos à prova o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, como alguns deles [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] puseram à prova, e eram destruídos pelas serpentes.
pt.B: Também não devemos pôr à prova a paciência {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, como alguns deles fizeram; eles foram sendo mortos pelas serpentes, um depois do outro.
pt.R: Não devemos tentar ver até onde podemos provocar {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, como alguns deles fizeram. As cobras os picaram, e eles morreram.

am.L: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ [እርሱን] እንደ ፈተኑ {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} አንፈታተን፤ በእባቦቹም ይጠፉ ነበር።
am.B: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት {{christos:የክርስቶስን|የመሲሑን}} ትዕግሥት አንፈታተን፤ እነርሱ በእባቦች ተነድፈው አንዱ በሌላው ላይ እየሞቱ ጠፉ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሑን}} እስከ ምን ድረስ እንደሚታገሠን ለማየት መሞከር የለብንም። እባቦች ነደፏቸው፤ እነርሱም ሞቱ።

hi.L: और न हम मसीह को परखें, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने [उन्हें] परखा, और साँपों के द्वारा नाश होते गए।
hi.B: हम मसीह के धीरज की परीक्षा न लें, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने ली; और साँपों ने उन्हें एक एक करके मार डाला।
hi.R: हमें यह देखने की कोशिश नहीं करनी चाहिए कि मसीह हमें कहाँ तक सहेंगे, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने की। साँपों ने उन्हें डसा, और वे मर गए।

ru.L: И не будем искушать {{christos:Христа|Мессию}}, как некоторые из них искушали [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}], и погибали от змей.
ru.B: Не будем испытывать терпение {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, как испытывали его некоторые из них: их одного за другим убивали змеи.
ru.R: Мы не должны проверять, как далеко можно зайти с {{christos:Христом|Мессией}}, как это делали некоторые из них. Их кусали змеи, и они умирали.

uk.L: І не випробовуймо {{christos:Христа|Месії}}, як деякі з них випробовували [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}], і гинули від зміїв.
uk.B: І не випробовуймо терпіння {{christos:Христа|Месії}}, як дехто з них випробовував його; вони один за одним гинули від зміїв.
uk.R: Ми не повинні перевіряти, як далеко можна зайти з {{christos:Христом|Месією}}, як це робили деякі з них. Їх кусали змії, і вони вмирали.

ja.L: また、わたしたちは{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を試みないようにしましょう。彼らのうちのある人たちは[{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を]試み、蛇によって滅ぼされていきました。
ja.B: また、彼らのうちのある人たちがしたように、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を試みることのないようにしましょう。彼らは蛇にかまれて、次々に滅んでいったのです。
ja.R: わたしたちは、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がどこまでがまんしてくださるかを試すようなことをしてはいけません。彼らのうちのある人たちは、そうしたので、蛇にかまれて死んでしまいました。

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "Christ"
alternatives: "the Lord", found in other early manuscripts
decisions.reason: The manuscripts differ here. "Christ" is found in the earliest papyrus and in many later manuscripts; several important early manuscripts read "the Lord", and a few "God". "Christ" is the harder reading, since a copyist would more readily change a statement that Israel tested Christ than create one, and it fits verse 4. The SBLGNT text governs. The evidence here is described from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: Israel put Christ to the test: Christ was present with Israel in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Verse 4 has already said that the rock was Christ. Testing God in the wilderness (Psalm 78:18; 95:9) was therefore testing Christ, and the Corinthians are in danger of doing the same.

decisions.choice: the serpents: Numbers 21:4-9
decisions.reason: The people spoke against God and Moses, complaining about the manna, and God sent poisonous snakes among them, so that many died.

decisions.choice: put to the test: provoke God by demanding that he prove himself, to see how far one can go
decisions.reason: ἐκπειράζωμεν is a strengthened form of πειράζω. To test God is to challenge his patience and faithfulness instead of trusting him (Deuteronomy 6:16). For the Corinthians it would mean going on eating at idol feasts as if the Lord would not care (verse 22).

decisions.choice: were destroyed: the imperfect tense pictures the deaths going on, one after another
decisions.reason: ἀπώλλυντο is imperfect, unlike the single act of the other verbs.

decisions.choice: try the patience of (B); try to see how far we can push (R)
decisions.reason: In current speech "test" can sound like an exam; Balanced and Readable say what testing God means here (m4).

decisions.choice: [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the object, a pronoun for Christ.

decisions.choice: [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the object the Greek leaves out, as the English does, and the pronoun for Christ before the verb takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: walivyomjaribu: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English supplies [him] with a span; in Swahili the object is the marker -m- inside the verb, which cannot take a capital, so there is no span and nothing to bracket.

decisions.choice: kumjaribu (L, R); kuijaribu subira yake (B)
decisions.reason: The same verb "kujaribu" as the noun "jaribu" in verse 13, so the link between Israel testing Christ and the testing believers face stays visible.

decisions.choice: "thử" (L), "thử thách lòng nhẫn nại của" (B), "thách thức" (R) for ekpeirazo; "thử thách" kept for peirasmos in 10:13
decisions.reason: The verb of testing is kept, so that 10:13 can be heard as its answer: Israel tested Christ; God sets a limit to the testing of his people.

decisions.choice: [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the object pronoun for Christ, as the English does; Portuguese puts it before the verb.

decisions.choice: "መፈታተን" (put to the test) at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: "ፈተነ" is also the book's word for the testing God allows in verse 13; the intensive "ተፈታተነ" is provoking someone to prove himself (m4), which is what Israel did.

decisions.choice: "[उन्हें]", no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect for Christ is carried by the honorific "उन्हें" (style guide section 7). This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: "धीरज की परीक्षा न लें" (B); "कहाँ तक सहेंगे" (R)
decisions.reason: Testing God here means provoking him to see how far one can go (meaning decision m4); "परीक्षा" alone could sound like an exam. Literal keeps "परखना".

decisions.choice: искушать
decisions.reason: "Искушать" with a person as object is the Russian for provoking God by demanding proof (meaning decision m4); Balanced and Readable say what it means. The "его" in "испытывали его" (B) is the patience, not Christ, so it takes no span.

decisions.choice: випробовуймо {{christos:Христа|Месії}}
decisions.reason: m4: to put to the test is to provoke God by demanding that he prove himself. "Випробовувати" keeps that, and its link with the testing of 10:13; "спокушати" would now mean tempting him to sin.

source.text: μηδὲ γογγύζετε, καθάπερ τινὲς αὐτῶν ἐγόγγυσαν, καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὑπὸ τοῦ ὀλοθρευτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Neither grumble, as some of them grumbled, and perished by the Destroyer.

en.L: Nor grumble, as some of them grumbled, and they perished by the Destroyer.
en.B: Do not grumble against God, the way some of them grumbled, only to perish at the hand of the Destroyer.
en.R: Do not complain against God, as some of them did. The angel God sent to bring death destroyed them.

fr.L: Ne murmurez pas non plus, comme certains d’entre eux ont murmuré, et ils ont péri par le Destructeur.
fr.B: Ne récriminez pas contre Dieu, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait, et ils ont péri sous les coups du Destructeur.
fr.R: Ne vous plaignez pas de Dieu, comme certains d’entre eux l’ont fait. L’ange que Dieu avait envoyé pour apporter la mort les a tués.

es.L: Ni {{plural_you:murmuren|murmuréis}}, como algunos de ellos murmuraron, y perecieron a manos del Destructor.
es.B: No {{plural_you:murmuren|murmuréis}} contra Dios, como murmuraron algunos de ellos, que acabaron pereciendo a manos del Destructor.
es.R: No {{plural_you:se quejen|os quejéis}} contra Dios, como hicieron algunos de ellos. El ángel que Dios envió para traer la muerte los destruyó.

sw.L: Wala msinung'unike, kama baadhi yao walivyonung'unika, nao wakaangamizwa na Mwangamizi.
sw.B: Msimnung'unikie Mungu kama baadhi yao walivyonung'unika, wakaangamia kwa mkono wa Mwangamizi.
sw.R: Msimlalamikie Mungu kama baadhi yao walivyofanya. Malaika ambaye Mungu alimtuma kuleta kifo aliwaangamiza.

vi.L: Cũng đừng lằm bằm, như một số người trong họ đã lằm bằm, và đã bị Đấng Hủy Diệt tiêu diệt.
vi.B: Đừng lằm bằm chống lại Đức Chúa Trời như một số người trong họ đã lằm bằm, để rồi bị thiên sứ hủy diệt giết chết.
vi.R: Đừng than phiền chống lại Đức Chúa Trời như một số người trong họ đã làm. Thiên sứ mà Đức Chúa Trời sai đến để đem sự chết đã tiêu diệt họ.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들이 원망하다가 멸망시키는 자에게 멸망한 것처럼, 여러분도 원망하지 마십시오.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들처럼 하나님을 원망하지 마십시오. 그들은 원망하다가 멸망시키는 천사에게 죽임을 당했습니다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 어떤 사람들처럼 하나님께 불평하지 마십시오. 하나님께서 죽음을 내리시려고 보내신 천사가 그들을 멸망시켰습니다.

pt.L: Nem murmurem, como alguns deles murmuraram, e pereceram pelo Destruidor.
pt.B: Não murmurem contra Deus, como alguns deles murmuraram e acabaram morrendo pela mão do Destruidor.
pt.R: Não reclamem contra Deus, como alguns deles fizeram. O anjo que Deus mandou para trazer a morte destruiu essas pessoas.

am.L: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ እንዳጉረመረሙ አታጉረምርሙ፤ በአጥፊውም ጠፉ።
am.B: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳጉረመረሙ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አታጉረምርሙ፤ እነርሱም በአጥፊው እጅ ጠፉ።
am.R: ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ እንዳደረጉት በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አታማርሩ። እግዚአብሔር ሞትን እንዲያመጣ የላከው መልአክ አጠፋቸው።

hi.L: और न कुड़कुड़ाओ, जैसे उनमें से कुछ कुड़कुड़ाए, और नाश करनेवाले के द्वारा नाश हुए।
hi.B: परमेश्वर के विरुद्ध कुड़कुड़ाओ मत, जैसे उनमें से कुछ कुड़कुड़ाए, और नाश करनेवाले के हाथों नाश हो गए।
hi.R: परमेश्वर के विरुद्ध शिकायत मत करो, जैसे उनमें से कुछ ने की। परमेश्वर ने मृत्यु लाने के लिए जिस स्वर्गदूत को भेजा, उसने उन्हें नाश कर दिया।

ru.L: И не ропщите, как некоторые из них роптали и погибли от Губителя.
ru.B: Не ропщите на Бога, как роптали некоторые из них и погибли от руки Губителя.
ru.R: Не жалуйтесь на Бога, как это делали некоторые из них. Их погубил ангел, которого Бог послал наказать их смертью.

uk.L: І не нарікайте, як деякі з них нарікали, і загинули від Губителя.
uk.B: Не нарікайте на Бога, як нарікали дехто з них і загинули від руки Губителя.
uk.R: Не скаржтеся на Бога, як дехто з них. Ангел, якого Бог послав нести смерть, погубив їх.

ja.L: また、つぶやいてはいけません。彼らのうちのある人たちはつぶやき、滅ぼす者によって滅びました。
ja.B: また、彼らのうちのある人たちのように、神に対してつぶやいてはいけません。彼らは滅ぼす者によって滅ぼされたのです。
ja.R: また、彼らのうちのある人たちのように、神に文句を言ってはいけません。神が送られた、死をもたらす天使が、彼らを滅ぼしてしまいました。

decisions.choice: the grumbling of Israel in the wilderness, and the death that followed
decisions.reason: Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and so against God, again and again (Exodus 16:2-12; Numbers 14:2, 27, 36). After the revolt of Korah the whole people grumbled, and a plague killed thousands (Numbers 16:41-49). Paul may have either story in mind.

decisions.choice: the Destroyer: the angel God sends to carry out his judgment
alternatives: a demon acting on its own
decisions.reason: ὀλοθρευτοῦ recalls "the destroyer" who struck Egypt on the night of the Passover (Exodus 12:23) and the destroying angel of 2 Samuel 24:16 and 1 Chronicles 21:15. The Numbers stories speak of a plague; Paul names the one who brought it.

decisions.choice: grumble: complain with resentment, accusing God of failing his people
decisions.reason: γογγύζετε is the word for Israel's grumbling in the Greek Old Testament. Paul uses a command, "do not grumble", as he did in verse 7.

decisions.choice: against God
decisions.reason: In the stories Paul recalls, grumbling against Moses was grumbling against God (Exodus 16:8; Numbers 14:27).

decisions.choice: The angel God sent to bring death
decisions.reason: Readable explains who the Destroyer was (m2).

decisions.choice: murmurer (L), récriminer (B), se plaindre (R); le Destructeur (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Murmurer" is the traditional word for Israel's grumbling, but today it mostly means to speak softly, so Balanced says "récriminer", resentful complaint (m3), and Readable "se plaindre". "Le Destructeur" follows the Greek word and the English; "l'Exterminateur" is the older French name for the angel of judgment (m2).

decisions.choice: murmurar
decisions.reason: "Murmurar" is the Spanish word for Israel's grumbling in the wilderness (m3), as in the Gospels; Readable says "quejarse".

decisions.choice: Mwangamizi
decisions.reason: "Mwangamizi" (one who destroys), capitalised as the English "Destroyer", the word used for the destroying angel in Hebrews 11:28 and Revelation 9:11.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Hủy Diệt" (L); "thiên sứ hủy diệt" (B); "Thiên sứ mà Đức Chúa Trời sai đến để đem sự chết" (R); "lằm bằm" (L, B), "than phiền" (R)
decisions.reason: The Destroyer is the angel God sends to carry out his judgment (m2); "kẻ" would make him an evildoer. "Lằm bằm" is the word of the Vietnamese Philippians 2:14.

decisions.choice: murmurar (L, B); reclamar (R)
decisions.reason: "Murmurar" is the Portuguese word for Israel's grumbling in the wilderness, a complaint full of resentment (m3); "resmungar" sounds trivial. Readable says "reclamar", the everyday verb.

decisions.choice: Губитель
decisions.reason: The angel God sends to carry out his judgment (meaning decision m2). "Губитель", capitalised as a title, says this; the Synodal "истребитель" now means a fighter plane.

decisions.choice: Губитель, with a capital
decisions.reason: The Destroyer is the angel God sends to carry out his judgment (m2), named as a title, as the English capitalises it.

decisions.choice: "滅ぼす者" (L, B); "死をもたらす天使" (R)
decisions.reason: The angel God sends to carry out judgment (m2).

source.text: ταῦτα δὲ τυπικῶς συνέβαινεν ἐκείνοις, ἐγράφη δὲ πρὸς νουθεσίαν ἡμῶν, εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν.

records.literal_gloss: These things now as examples were happening to those, were written but for admonition of us, to whom the ends of the ages have arrived.

en.L: Now these things kept happening to them by way of example, and they were written for our warning, to whom the ends of the ages have arrived.
en.B: What happened to them was meant as an example, and it was written down to warn us, who live at the time when the ages reach their end.
en.R: What happened to them was an example. It was written down as a warning for us, because we are living at the time when everything God planned for all the ages is coming to its goal.

fr.L: Or ces choses leur arrivaient pour servir d’exemple, et elles ont été écrites pour notre avertissement, à nous à qui sont parvenues les fins des âges.
fr.B: Ce qui leur est arrivé devait servir d’exemple, et cela a été mis par écrit pour nous avertir, nous qui vivons au temps où les âges arrivent à leur fin.
fr.R: Ce qui leur est arrivé est un exemple. Cela a été mis par écrit pour nous avertir, parce que nous vivons au moment où tout ce que Dieu avait prévu pour tous les âges arrive à son but.

es.L: Ahora bien, estas cosas les sucedían como ejemplo, y fueron escritas para advertencia nuestra, a quienes han llegado los fines de los siglos.
es.B: Lo que les pasó a ellos fue un ejemplo, y quedó escrito para advertirnos a nosotros, que vivimos en el tiempo en que los siglos llegan a su fin.
es.R: Lo que les pasó fue un ejemplo. Quedó escrito como advertencia para nosotros, porque vivimos en el tiempo en que todo lo que Dios planeó a lo largo de los siglos está llegando a su meta.

sw.L: Basi mambo haya yalikuwa yakiwapata wao kwa njia ya mfano, nayo yaliandikwa kwa ajili ya kutuonya sisi, ambao miisho ya zama imetufikia.
sw.B: Yaliyowapata yalikusudiwa kuwa mfano, nayo yaliandikwa ili kutuonya sisi tunaoishi wakati ambapo zama zinafikia mwisho wake.
sw.R: Yaliyowapata yalikuwa mfano. Yaliandikwa ili yawe onyo kwetu, kwa sababu tunaishi wakati ambapo kila kitu ambacho Mungu alipanga kwa zama zote kinafikia lengo lake.

vi.L: Những điều này đã xảy đến cho họ để làm gương, và đã được chép lại để cảnh cáo chúng ta, là những người mà cuối cùng của các thời đại đã đến.
vi.B: Những gì đã xảy ra cho họ là để làm gương, và đã được chép lại để cảnh cáo chúng ta, những người đang sống vào lúc các thời đại đi đến chỗ kết thúc.
vi.R: Những gì đã xảy ra cho họ là một tấm gương. Những điều ấy đã được chép lại để làm lời cảnh cáo cho chúng ta, vì chúng ta đang sống vào lúc mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã hoạch định qua các thời đại đang đi đến đích.

ko.L: 이 일들이 본보기로 그들에게 일어났고, 세대들의 끝을 맞이한 우리에게 경고하려고 기록되었습니다.
ko.B: 그들에게 일어난 이 일들은 본보기가 되었습니다. 그리고 그것은 세대들이 끝에 이른 때에 사는 우리에게 경고하려고 기록되었습니다.
ko.R: 그들에게 일어난 일은 본보기였습니다. 그 일은 우리에게 경고하려고 기록되었습니다. 우리는 하나님께서 모든 시대를 위해 계획하신 일이 그 목표에 이르는 때에 살고 있기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Ora, estas coisas lhes aconteciam como exemplo, e foram escritas para advertência nossa, a quem os fins das eras chegaram.
pt.B: O que aconteceu com eles serviu de exemplo, e foi escrito para nos advertir, a nós que vivemos no tempo em que as eras chegam ao seu fim.
pt.R: O que aconteceu com eles foi um exemplo. Isso foi escrito como advertência para nós, porque estamos vivendo no tempo em que tudo o que Deus planejou para todas as eras está chegando ao seu objetivo.

am.L: እነዚህም ነገሮች በምሳሌ መንገድ በእነዚያ ላይ ይደርሱ ነበር፤ የዘመናት ፍጻሜ ለደረሰብን ለእኛ ለማስጠንቀቂያ ግን ተጻፉ።
am.B: በእነርሱ ላይ የሆነው ምሳሌ እንዲሆን ነበር፤ የተጻፈውም የዘመናት ፍጻሜ በደረሰበት ጊዜ የምንኖረውን እኛን ለማስጠንቀቅ ነው።
am.R: በእነርሱ ላይ የሆነው ምሳሌ ነው። ለእኛ ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዲሆን ተጻፈ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘመናት ሁሉ ያቀደው ነገር ወደ ፍጻሜው በሚደርስበት ጊዜ እንኖራለንና።

hi.L: पर ये बातें उन पर उदाहरण के रूप में घटती रहीं, और वे हमारी चेतावनी के लिए लिखी गईं, जिन पर युगों के अंत आ पहुँचे हैं।
hi.B: उनके साथ जो हुआ, वह उदाहरण के रूप में हुआ, और वह हमें सावधान करने के लिए लिखा गया, जो उस समय में जी रहे हैं जब युग अपने अंत पर पहुँच रहे हैं।
hi.R: उनके साथ जो हुआ, वह एक उदाहरण था। वह हमारी चेतावनी के लिए लिखा गया, क्योंकि हम उस समय में जी रहे हैं जब परमेश्वर ने सारे युगों के लिए जो कुछ ठहराया था, वह अपने लक्ष्य पर पहुँच रहा है।

ru.L: Это же случалось с ними как прообразы, а написано было для вразумления нас, до которых дошли концы веков.
ru.B: То, что произошло с ними, было примером, и это было записано, чтобы предостеречь нас, живущих в то время, когда века приходят к концу.
ru.R: То, что случилось с ними, было примером. Это записано как предупреждение для нас, потому что мы живём в то время, когда всё, что Бог задумал на все века, приходит к своей цели.

uk.L: А це все траплялося з ними як приклад, а написано для нашого напоумлення, до яких дійшли кінці віків.
uk.B: Те, що з ними сталося, мало бути прикладом, і записане, щоб застерегти нас, що живемо тоді, коли віки досягають свого кінця.
uk.R: Те, що з ними сталося, було прикладом. Це записано як застереження для нас, бо ми живемо в час, коли все, що Бог задумав для всіх віків, доходить до своєї мети.

ja.L: さて、これらのことは手本として彼らに起こり続けたのであり、諸時代の終わりが到来しているわたしたちへの警告のために書かれたのです。
ja.B: 彼らに起こったこれらのことは、手本となるためのものでした。そして、それは、時代の終わりに生きているわたしたちに警告するために書き記されたのです。
ja.R: 彼らに起こったことは、わたしたちへの手本です。そして、それはわたしたちへの警告として書き残されました。わたしたちは今、神がすべての時代のために計画されたことが、ついに実現しようとしている時に生きているからです。

decisions.choice: as examples: in a way that makes them patterns and warnings
decisions.reason: τυπικῶς picks up τύποι from verse 6 (m1 there): God shaped these events to speak to later generations.

decisions.choice: warning: instruction that corrects and puts a person on guard
decisions.reason: νουθεσίαν is instruction aimed at changing behavior, often a warning (compare Ephesians 6:4).

decisions.choice: the ends of the ages have come: believers live at the time when the ages reach their goal in Christ
alternatives: the end of the world is about to happen
the end of the old age overlapping the start of the new
decisions.reason: Since Christ came, history has reached its last stage, the time God's promises looked toward. The plural "ends" may picture all the earlier ages reaching their goal together. Because the church lives at this decisive time, the Scriptures about Israel were written with it in view (compare Romans 15:4).

decisions.choice: kept happening: the imperfect tense pictures the events one after another
decisions.reason: συνέβαινεν is imperfect; ἐγράφη is a single act, "were written".

decisions.choice: who live at the time when the ages reach their end
alternatives: on whom the ends of the ages have come
decisions.reason: The literal phrase is hard to follow; Balanced says what it means while keeping "the ages".

decisions.choice: because we are living at the time when everything God planned for all the ages is coming to its goal
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase (m3) and makes the link to "warning for us" explicit.

decisions.choice: los siglos
decisions.reason: "The ages" is said in Spanish as "los siglos", as in 2:7 ("antes de los siglos"); "las eras" is kept for "this age".

decisions.choice: miisho ya zama (L); zama zinafikia mwisho wake (B)
decisions.reason: "Zama" is the project's word for aion (this age, the age to come); the plural "ends of the ages" is kept, not "the end of the world".

source.text: ὥστε ὁ δοκῶν ἑστάναι βλεπέτω μὴ πέσῃ, πειρασμὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ εἴληφεν εἰ μὴ ἀνθρώπινος· πιστὸς δὲ ὁ θεός, ὃς οὐκ ἐάσει ὑμᾶς πειρασθῆναι ὑπὲρ ὃ δύνασθε, ἀλλὰ ποιήσει σὺν τῷ πειρασμῷ καὶ τὴν ἔκβασιν τοῦ δύνασθαι ὑπενεγκεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: So that the [one] thinking to stand let him watch lest he fall. \v 13 Testing you not has taken except human; faithful but [is] the God, who not will allow you to be tested beyond what you are able, but will make with the testing also the way out of the to be able to endure.

en.L: So let the one who thinks {{gender:they stand|he stands}} watch out lest {{gender:they|he}} fall. \v 13 No testing has taken hold of you except [what is] human; but God [is] faithful, who will not let you be tested beyond what you are able, but with the testing will also make the way out, so that you are able to bear [it].
en.B: So anyone who feels sure of standing should watch out, or {{gender:they|he}} may fall. \v 13 The testing that has gripped you is only what all people face. But God is faithful, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not allow the testing to go past your strength. Along with the testing {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will also make the way out, so that you are able to hold up under it.
en.R: So if you think you are standing strong, be careful. You too could fall. \v 13 The tests you face are the same kind that all people face. But you can trust God. He will not let you be tested more than you can stand. When a test comes, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will also open a way through it for you, and you will be able to stand up under it.
